name: Tax Year
insp: Swiss-tech product UI and airport departure boards
desc: Precise, product-like and built around the NZ tax year. The hero counts down live to your next Inland Revenue date on split-flap digits, over a duotone photo that wipes open. Then the whole year, April to March, slides past sideways as you scroll, with this month marked.
fx: Live countdown to the next IRD date on rolling split-flap digits
Brand-blue duotone that wipes off the hero photo on load
Pinned sideways journey through twelve months, with a progress line and today marker
Service cards that fan out from a stacked deck
Headings and the testimonial rise line by line through masks
Magnetic buttons and portrait previews on hover
